008package paint.shared.validate;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
011import tech.tablesaw.api.ColumnType;
012
013import java.io.File;
014import java.util.ArrayList;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * Validates the structure and data of {@code experiment_info.csv}.
019 *
020 * <p>This updated version uses the embedded schema in
021 * {@link paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo.Column ExperimentInfo.Column} instead of ExperimentInfoSchema.</p>
022 *
023 * <p>Performs:</p>
024 * <ul>
025 *   <li>Header validation</li>
026 *   <li>Type validation</li>
027 *   <li>Condition-level consistency validation</li>
028 * </ul>
029 */
030public final class ExperimentInfoValidator extends AbstractFileValidator {
031
032    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
033    // HEADER VALIDATION
034    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
035
036    /**
037     * Validates that the actual CSV headers match the expected headers defined in
038     * {@link paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo.Column ExperimentInfo.Column}.
039     *
040     * @param actualHeader the list of headers found in the CSV file
041     * @param result       the {@link ValidationResult} to record any mismatches
042     */
043    @Override
044    protected void validateHeader(List<String> actualHeader, ValidationResult result) {
045
046        List<String> expected = new ArrayList<>();
047
048        for (ExperimentInfo.Column col : ExperimentInfo.Column.values()) {
049            expected.add(col.header);
050        }
051
052        headersMatch(expected, actualHeader, result);
053    }
054
055    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
056    // TYPE VALIDATION
057    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
058
059    /**
060     * Returns the expected {@link ColumnType} for each column in the experiment info CSV,
061     * as defined in {@link paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo.Column ExperimentInfo.Column}.
062     *
063     * @return an array of expected column types
064     */
065    @Override
066    protected ColumnType[] getExpectedTypes() {
067
068        ExperimentInfo.Column[] cols  = ExperimentInfo.Column.values();
069        ColumnType[]            types = new ColumnType[cols.length];
070
071        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
072            types[i] = cols[i].type;
073        }
074
075        return types;
076    }
077
078    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
079    // CONSISTENCY CHECK
080    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
081
082    /**
083     * Performs full validation (header + type) plus logical
084     * consistency check across rows sharing the same condition number.
085     *
086     * @param file the experiment info CSV file to validate
087     * @return the aggregated {@link ValidationResult}
088     */
089    public ValidationResult validateWithConsistency(File file) {
090
091        ValidationResult result = validate(file);
092
093        if (result.isValid()) {
094            result.merge(ConditionConsistencyChecker.check(file));
095        }
096
097        return result;
098    }
099}
